purpose: Prevent accidental GitHub Actions spend before the alpha.4 integration tree is final.

safeRemoteOperation.rationale: Current push-triggered workflows are scoped to main/master or tags; the upgrade branch has no ordinary push-triggered workflow.

blockedUntilFinalAcceptance.reason: The alpha.4 integration diff fans out into multiple pull_request workflows; open the PR only after consolidated acceptance passes.

acceptedBaseline.note: Exact alpha.4 Candidate Source manifests, pnpm lock, Desktop npm runtime lock, complete DSH-family overrides, reviewed lifecycle policy, and four upstream contract snapshots. Temporary registry/generator workflows and triggers were removed before this baseline was squashed.

finalAcceptance.disposition: PR remains blocked until the alpha.4 consolidated acceptance runner passes on the final tree.
